issues.issue: Is Mr. Seshaw precluded from seeking judicial review of the visa officer's H&C refusal?
issues.result_quote: On the basis of the reasoning in Habtenkiel, Mr. Seshaw had the right to bring an application for judicial review from the visa officer’s dismissal of his H&C application.

issues.issue: Was the visa officer's refusal of the H&C application reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Visa officer's H&C decision was unreasonable.
issues.respondent_position: Visa officer's decision on the H&C application was reasonable.
issues.result_quote: In the result, I find that the visa officer’s decision, though terse, was reasonable in the circumstances.

issues.issue: What is the effect of the visa officer's finding that Ms. Gebru was in default on an immigration loan?
issues.applicant_position: Argued the visa officer erred in finding Ms. Gebru in default on an immigration loan.
issues.respondent_position: Argued the loan-default point was immaterial but correct.
issues.result_quote: But I need not decide this issue.
